title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
keyIdea: Answer queries offline, from smallest to largest. Sort intervals by left end; for each query push every interval that has started (keyed by size), pop from the top while it has already ended, and the top is the smallest interval containing the query.

approaches.name: Sort + min-heap (offline queries)
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Sort intervals by left and query indexes by value; heap of (size, right); push started, pop ended, read the top.
approaches.time: O(n log n + q log q)
approaches.why: Each interval is pushed and popped at most once; both lists are sorted once.

options: As queries grow, an interval that started stays started and one that ended stays ended, so each is pushed/popped once
